title: Standards Control Vocabulary v1
description: The shared, versioned vocabulary for standards registers across FuroField, FuroTrack, LITS and Dzinza. This file MUST be byte-identical in every repo that consumes it; each repo hashes it and fails CI on drift. Normative standard text is copyrighted and is never reproduced here or in a register: a control carries a clause identifier, our own paraphrase, and a citation URL.

vocabularyVersion.description: Must equal the vocabularyVersion of this schema. A mismatch is a conformance failure, not a warning.

Family.description: The four standard families this program covers.

Status.description: Implementation state of a control. 'external_assessment' is the honest terminal state for anything only an accredited third party can confer (ISO 27001 certificate, SOC 2 report, GlobalG.A.P. certificate, phytosanitary certificate): it means the controls are in place and the engagement has not happened. Rendering it as 'certified' or 'compliant' is forbidden and is enforced by the honesty guard.

EvidenceTier.description: The provenance ladder already used across these products. A roll-up inherits the weakest tier present.

AppliesTo.description: Product authority or deployment plane a control binds to. Kept explicit so one engine register can serve two authorities without crossing the product-isolation boundary.

id.description: Stable slug, unique across all four repos so a control can be traced across the seam. Lowercase, dots for hierarchy.

body.description: The publishing body or legislator, e.g. 'ISO/IEC', 'WOAH', 'European Union', 'GS1', 'GLOBALG.A.P.'.

version.description: Edition/version as published, e.g. '2022', 'IFA v6 Smart', '2.0'. Omit when the instrument is not versioned.

effectiveDate.description: ISO 8601 date the cited edition took effect, where known.

citationUrl.description: Public URL for the instrument. Required: a standard with no citation cannot be verified before print.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, or 'EU' / 'INTL' / 'SADC' for supranational instruments. Empty means globally applicable.

verifyBeforePrint.description: True when a specific instrument number, date, tariff line or official's name in this entry has not yet been re-verified against a primary source. Customer-facing artefacts must flag, not assert, a true value.

id.description: Stable slug unique within the register.

standardId.description: Must resolve to a StandardEntry.id in the same register.

clauseRef.description: The clause/control/article identifier as published, e.g. 'A.5.15', 'Art. 9', 'FV-Smart 32.03.01', 'Ch. 4.2'. Identifiers are facts, not protected expression.

paraphrase.description: OUR OWN one-or-two-sentence statement of what the clause requires. Never the normative text: those are copyrighted. The copyright guard enforces this.

codePaths.description: Repo-relative paths implementing the control. Required non-empty when status is 'implemented' or 'partial'; the coverage gate also checks each path still exists.

testRefs.description: Test identifiers proving the control: a vitest file+name, a pytest node id, or a conformance-suite case id. Required non-empty when status is 'implemented'.

owner.description: Accountable role, not a person: e.g. 'platform-security', 'agronomy', 'registry-operations'.

lastReviewed.description: ISO 8601 date this entry was last checked against the code.

notes.description: Free text. REQUIRED and substantive when status is 'not_applicable' (a bare N/A is rejected) or 'external_assessment' (name what the engagement is).

seamPin.description: Names an interchange vocabulary this control pins across repos, e.g. 'es-attestation-category' or 'eudr-geometry'. The seam-parity test asserts both sides agree.
